messages.subject: ARIMA with Renjin
parts:
Hi Renjin team,
I am doing a bachelor thesis in which I am developing a Java application that use a algorithm to predict the outcome of time series data. I'd like to ask if ARIMA functions of Renjin is now stable enough to for analyzing and predicting time series with ARIMA?

Thank you.

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: ARIMA with Renjin
parts:
It looks like the ARIMA function in the stats packages relies on the BFGS optimization routine which isn't currently implemented in Renjin.

I believe we just need to import the C code for the BFGS routine as the GCC-Bridge compiler should now be able to handle it, but this hasn't been done yet.

This is actually on my list for August, so check back then!

Best,
Alex
